name: Id and machine-header refusal
description: Runs the production check that the outward write tools call on each text a write would send, and reports whether the write is refused and which ids or header labels it named.
advantages: Offline and exact, on the same code the tools run, and the writer is told which strings to replace.
disadvantages: Covers the id shapes and header labels written down only; a new id prefix or header label needs a case and a pattern.
